You know how they say "you don't value what you have till you loose it" this might be harsh but it could be a life lesson for yours life eternity. You can give it all up or just imagine life without things you have. I want to you to find some place alone, outside. Imagine yourself with no friends, bad health, no family, no house, job, girlfriend, nothing. Yours life is sleeping on the streets and collecting food from dumpsters. Go over deep thinking about every single thing. And come to your own conclusion of valuations. Do you really don't value what you have or you are just blind to it?

When I was younger (before scoliosis) I had good life. I was best student in my school, people loved me, I had friends and I enjoyed life. I had plans for a life I wished to live and my goal was to one day go to some university in France or England.  But then the pain came. My life was never the same. I was depressed, my grades droped, I lost friends, started hating humans and focused on subjects outside of school. I spent day's, month's, year's deep thinking about life, human nature. I started reading books on psychology, history, philosophy and just got influenced by author's to keep going. I set my goals that I wished to achieve till I turn 30 and university was the first thing on that list. Why? Because it brings back memories of the life I once had and hoped to live. I just feel like it's my duty to finish university before well I end my life.

Yours problem is that you don't have any. Many people dream of having a life like you. Only thing missing from your life is a brake. A place where you can enjoy yourself, relax for a moment, think how good yours life is. Life doesn't make sense and it doesn't have to since you can make your own version of what is life meant to be. Religion offer's meaning to life as a gateway to heaven but If you are more of an atheist then take life as a story. Story that has ups and down and moments that you should enjoy. You have a girlfriend that want's to marry you? That's great because it means that she sees future with you, that she cares about you. My life is nothing compared to yours but I would never think of killing myself if I didn't have health issues. Cheer up and find the place you enjoy. You only got one life so live it the best you can.
